name: 52501 · Ottumwa, IA
findings: ZIP 52501 (Ottumwa) has 157 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (17%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (39% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 52501 (Ottumwa) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 52501 (Ottumwa) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 60% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
